sources.title: MedPsy 4B — Hardware Requirements & Compatibility | llmrun
sources.snippet: MedPsy 4B — Hardware Requirements & GPU Compatibility Chat MedPsy 4B is a 4.4B-parameter open language model from qvac. It supports a context window of up to 262,144 tokens. At Q4_K_M it needs about 3.14 GB of VRAM — see which GPUs and Macs can run it below.
